case_number: 2023INSC805; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 4955 OF 2022; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 5041 OF 2022; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 4869 OF 2023

parties.respondent: Hiralal Somabhai Contractor (DECEASED) REP. BY LRS. & ORS.

summary: Wilful disobedience of consent order prohibiting property transfer during litigation; contempt for executing 13 sale deeds post-undertaking; undertaking recorded ad-invitum; sale transactions void ab initio; punishment: fines ranging Rs.2,000-1,00,000; imprisonment for 2 months to accused 3.3-3.4 & accused 4; purchasers ordered to return properties; limitation/delay arguments dismissed; stay granted for 4 weeks subject to deposit.
final_judgment: Appeals partially allowed; contempt upheld; sale deeds declared void; fines/imprisonment confirmed; purchasers to recover consideration from contemnors; stay of 4 weeks granted subject to deposit.
